articles.title: US Federal Reserve expected to hold rates steady as inflation swirls
articles.content: The US Federal Reserve is set to hold its second meeting under new chairman Kevin Warsh starting Tuesday, with markets expecting policymakers to keep interest rates steady amid inflation concerns that could be exacerbated by US President Donald Trump's renewed war on Iran. Most investors expect the Fed to hold rates steady at 3.50-3.75 percent for the fifth straight meeting, according to CME's FedWatch monitoring tool.

articles.title: IDFC First Bank Q1 profit tops 1,000 cr
articles.content: IDFC First Bank reported its highest-ever quarterly profit at ₹1,075 crore for June, more than doubling year-on-year, driven by strong NII growth and lower provisions. Margins and return ratios improved, while loan growth remained robust across segments. Management highlighted improving asset quality and sustained business momentum despite provisioning buffers.

articles.title: NTPC board approves raising up to Rs 12,000 cr via NCD issue
articles.content: NTPC's board approved raising Rs 12,000 crore via non-convertible debentures. The company's group installed capacity grew to 90,904 MW by June 2026. Commercial power generation rose to 93.63 billion units in the April-June quarter. Coal-based plant load factor improved to 76.71 percent during this period. The average tariff remained stable at Rs 4.86 per unit.

articles.title: Bitcoin stays near $64K, Ethereum underperforms as weak risk appetite keeps crypto markets under pressure
articles.content: Bitcoin traded near $64,000 and Ethereum underperformed as risk appetite weakened. The global crypto market capitalization edged down 2% to $2.19 trillion. Bitcoin's realized volatility is near multi-year lows, suggesting a coiled market. Ethereum remained comparatively weaker below key support levels. Market sentiment improved early on regulatory news but then pulled back.
